clips.title: The story
paras: Rendered Spores are a volatile emulsion prepared from fungal samples gathered across the Barrens. Created by Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads, the mixture decays rapidly unless swiftly delivered to Apothecary Zamah beneath Thunder Bluff for stabilizing.

After acquiring strange fungal spores from mushrooms near the damp oases of the Barrens, Apothecary Helbrim processes them into an active chemical emulsion known as Rendered Spores. The delicate extraction suspends the potent compounds of the fungal growths in a liquid medium, but the solution is chemically unstable. It maintains its vital potency for only forty-five minutes before breaking down and becoming completely useless for scientific study.

Because Helbrim lacks the necessary facilities or time at his remote outpost to complete the refining process, the emulsion must be rushed directly to his Forsaken colleague, Apothecary Zamah. Hidden away in the subterranean Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, Zamah possesses the specialized equipment and reagents needed to reseal and finish processing the spores for the Royal Apothecary Society.
